name: Dash node census (dash-nodes)
author: PastaPastaPasta
description: Crawler and monitor behind the node pages of DashHQ Radar: every 15 minutes it handshakes with Dash nodes and masternodes on IPv4, IPv6, Tor, I2P and CJDNS and records versions, heights, hosting and reachability, with a map and speed tests. nodes.dashhq.org serves the same site as radar.dashhq.org.
